one_sentence_conflict: A courier can move after the whole city freezes, but every rescue shortens the time before he freezes too.
audience: 16-35 short-form suspense and high-concept fantasy viewers
click_reason: An impossible visual event is understandable immediately and creates a question that demands an answer.
hook_3s: A crowded street freezes in place while one courier keeps moving.
viewer_payoff: Each episode resolves one anomaly rule while revealing a larger serial mystery.
follow_reason: The same protagonist and anomaly system escalate across episodes, with a cliffhanger that changes the next rule.
series_engine_30: Thirty anomalies can be generated from the same rule system; each episode contains one local problem plus one step in the serial mystery.
monetization_route: platform revenue first; sponsorship, licensing, and IP extensions only after audience validation

cheapest_mvp.production_limit: 5-8 simple shots, one lead, no complex lip sync, one or two locations

ai_production_fit: AI-native: visual anomaly, limited cast, voice-over-led narration, short clips, simple motion, controllable locations.
platform_hypothesis: Use one short-form discovery platform for the first controlled test; repurpose only after a concept proves retention and follow intent.

mvp_evidence.success_criteria: Declare project-specific retention, completion, follow, save/comment, cost, and production-time thresholds before publishing the MVP set.
